title: Cyberpunk 2077 VR controls

bindings.note: Move at one speed. Hold fully forward for 0.2 seconds to sprint. With scanner open, push fully up/down to page quickhacks.

bindings.action: Turn; fully up: dash; fully down: crouch

bindings.note: With a weapon drawn: drops magazine. With phone, radio or vehicle list open: closes it. Push right stick fully up to dash.
Applies the selected quickhack while the scanner is open.
Tags a target while scanning; fires during normal gameplay.
Also melee block. Hold with right stick to zoom while scanning.

bindings.action: Hand-to-holster equip / unequip; melee power modifier
Grab magazine / toggle scanner at left ear

bindings.note: Hold both stick clicks for half a second. F10 or Insert opens the settings overlay.
Slide release during physical reload. Changes scanner tab while the scanner is open.
Combine with left grip for iconic cyberware, or right stick click for the VR menu.
Hold for 0.5 seconds during gameplay; requires Input Loader.

devices.context: Default actions from CyberpunkVR Port 0.1.9. Scanner, driving and menu contexts differ. Click a control to change compatible assignments for the next VR launch.
devices.custom_context: Your saved AVRcade assignments. Scanner and gesture actions follow their remapped controls. In-game prompts can still show original buttons.

note: Source checked against dariulone's CyberpunkVR Port 0.1.9 controls. Edit compatible bindings here before launching. Save your preferred layout as your defaults for this game and controller. F10 or the listed stick-click chord opens the upstream HUD settings. Physical gestures and stick tilt retain the conversion's behavior; in-game rebinding can change the actions behind these defaults. Headset validation of custom layouts is pending.
